# html2canvas

Bundled dependency, used to rasterize the banner markup in the browser.

- Version: 1.4.1
- License: MIT
- Upstream: https://github.com/niklasvh/html2canvas
- File: `html2canvas.min.js`, the official distribution build of the tag `v1.4.1`
  (https://github.com/niklasvh/html2canvas/releases/tag/v1.4.1)

Nothing in this folder is modified. To update, replace the file with the newer
official build and bump the version passed to `wp_enqueue_script()` in
`includes/class-banners-og-plugin.php`.
